workflow_runs.name: blocking-ci
workflow_runs.display_title: evidence(hcsn): preserve and index the P0–P5 research source chain

head_commit.message:
evidence(hcsn): index frozen P0-P5 snapshot and scoped cost ledger

Bind 472 curated original files to byte hashes, exact source/model/data/config/log references, 55 scoped cost entries and independent baseline36+C1 results. This mechanical archival snapshot retains the last original-HCSN observation at 18:01 UTC; later terminal and numerical evidence are a separate package. No full-training numerical qualification or scientific benefit is granted.

head_commit.message:
docs(hcsn): specify temporal-core fairness and continuation evidence

Document the executable common frontend/head and learnable core adapter, all seven cores, actual dispatch-dependent budgets, diagnostic reset, microbatch semantics, source retention and C1 scope. Constructor support, finite fixtures and implementation tests do not grant full numerical or scientific admission.
